sourceFile: 27. TIU C11-20  Report Test Frame damage mesh 2026.03.28. - RAW soundcheck_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable rows but misgroups model/type baselines and includes unreliable RAW measurement statistics.
issues: Changed factor mixes shift, model side, and frame types as one test condition.
L-side Type 2/4 are compared to R-side Normal instead of L-side Normal.
Type 4 defect delta ignores L Normal NG rate.
RAW SPL/THD measurement extraction includes headers, frequencies, and IDs as values.
Review title and purpose are raw-row fragments, not a usable case summary.
correctionPlan: Define primary factor as frame mesh test type versus Normal, preserving R/L model side.
Create separate subgroup comparisons: R Type 1/3 vs R Normal and L Type 2/4 vs L Normal.
Recalculate function NG rates and deltas using Test rows 16,18,20,22,24,26.
Either remove RAW measurement outcomes or rebuild them by frequency and sample columns with valid SPL/THD units.
Rewrite title, purpose, changed factor, and limitations from the Test sheet context.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but several are misapplied; citations are not sufficient until grouping and RAW extraction are corrected.
